EDITOR_DESCRIPTION: Set shared context and preferences that apply to every project in this workspace.
PROJECT_EDITOR_DESCRIPTION: Add context that only this project needs. Keep it alongside team knowledge or replace the team version for this project.
EDITOR_HELP: Use plain language. Include durable facts, audience, tone, preferences, and rules that should stay consistent.
EDITOR_FAQ_DESCRIPTION: Keep information here when it should shape many projects over time. Put one-off requests directly in the relevant conversation.
EDITOR_FAQ_BUSINESS_QUESTION: What business information should I include?
EDITOR_FAQ_BUSINESS_ANSWER: Describe your product or service, target audience, core use cases, and what makes the business distinct. Prioritize facts that multiple projects will reuse and that are unlikely to change soon.
EDITOR_FAQ_VOICE_QUESTION: How should I define the brand voice?
EDITOR_FAQ_VOICE_ANSWER: Set the default language, tone, preferred terms, and wording to avoid. For example: professional without sounding formal, and never make exaggerated claims.
EDITOR_FAQ_RULES_ANSWER: Add stable rules every project must follow, such as compliance requirements, content boundaries, or technical conventions. Keep task-specific instructions in the conversation where they apply.
EDITOR_PLACEHOLDER: Add the context and preferences you want Arclayer to remember...
REMOVED_DESCRIPTION: Save a new draft and publish it to make workspace knowledge active again.
PROJECT_REMOVED_DESCRIPTION: Earlier project versions are still available. Restore one from version history before publishing again.
PROJECT_MODE_HELP: Add to team knowledge for project-specific context. Replace it only when this project must follow a different set of instructions.
NO_REVISION_YET: No revision has been created yet.
EFFECTIVE_DESCRIPTION: Review the exact knowledge available to AI work in this scope. Project instructions can add to or replace team knowledge.
EFFECTIVE_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Save a draft and publish it before AI work can use this knowledge.
CONFLICT_OVERRIDE_DESCRIPTION: AI work in the selected project uses its project instructions instead of the team version.
UNAVAILABLE_UNPUBLISHED_TITLE: This knowledge is still a draft
UNAVAILABLE_UNPUBLISHED_DESCRIPTION: Publish the draft before AI work can use it.
UNAVAILABLE_REMOVED_DESCRIPTION: Restore an earlier version if AI work should use it again.
PROJECTS_LOAD_FAILED_DESCRIPTION: The workspace preview remains available. Try again to choose a project preview.
HISTORY_DESCRIPTION: Review earlier drafts and published updates. Restoring creates a new draft, so previous versions remain unchanged.
HISTORY_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: The first saved draft will appear here.
RESTORE_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION: Restoring creates a new draft from this revision. It does not publish the revision automatically.
PROJECT_RESTORE_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION: Restoring creates a new project draft from this revision. It does not publish the revision automatically.
REMOVE_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION: Removing shared guidance makes it unavailable to future work. Existing revision history is retained.
PROJECT_REMOVE_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION: Removing project guidance makes it unavailable to future work in this project. Existing revision history is retained.
PREVIEW_STALE_TITLE: This preview is no longer current
PREVIEW_STALE_DESCRIPTION: Review the latest guidance state and create a new preview before applying this change.
APPLY_FAILED_DESCRIPTION: No changes were applied. Review the current guidance state and try again.
REFERENCES_DESCRIPTION: Connect source collections when AI needs facts or material beyond the instructions above.
PROJECT_SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: Manage guidance that applies only to this project and see what is currently in effect.
PROJECT_WORKSPACE_REQUIRED_TITLE: Choose a workspace to manage project guidance
PROJECT_WORKSPACE_REQUIRED_DESCRIPTION: Project guidance is scoped to the active workspace. Select the project from an available workspace and try again.
REFERENCES_DIRECTORY_DESCRIPTION: Create and maintain source collections that team knowledge and project instructions can reference.
REFERENCE_CREATE_DESCRIPTION: Group source material that the workspace can later attach to its guidance.
REFERENCE_NAME_HELP: Use a clear name that helps collaborators recognize this material.
REFERENCE_DIRECTORY_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Create a collection when your team has source material worth reusing.
REFERENCE_SOURCE_CREATE_DESCRIPTION: Add a manual page or a website that this collection can maintain.
REFERENCE_SOURCE_URL_HELP: Use a public HTTP or HTTPS address that the workspace is allowed to process.
REFERENCE_SOURCE_KEY_HELP: Optional label for organizing this manual page.
REFERENCE_SOURCE_EMPTY: No sources have been added to this collection.
REFERENCE_FRESHNESS_STALE: Last successful version is still in use
REFERENCE_PROCESSING_FAILED_DESCRIPTION: The last processing attempt did not complete. Existing ready material, if any, remains unchanged.
REFERENCE_PROCESSING_UNAVAILABLE: Processing is not currently available for this source.
REFERENCE_VERSION_CREATE_DESCRIPTION: Save a new version of this manual source. It becomes available after processing finishes.
REFERENCE_VERSION_CONTENT_HELP: Use the complete source text you want the workspace to process.
REFERENCE_CAPABILITIES_FAILED_TITLE: Available source types couldn't be loaded
REFERENCE_CAPABILITIES_FAILED_DESCRIPTIO: We couldn't determine which source types are available. Try again to see what this workspace can use.
REFERENCE_RETRIEVAL_UNAVAILABLE_DESCRIPT: Sources can be prepared, but the workspace cannot yet run a retrieval test or show citations from it.
